chunks: O sons of Adam, when apostles come to you from among you, who convey My messages, then those who take heed and amend will have neither fear nor regret.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for having no fear or sorrow according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the necessity of prophethood and the Imamate, with 'messengers from among you' seen as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt who guide the faithful. The promise of 'no fear nor sorrow' underscores the spiritual security attained through combining inner piety (taqwa) with outward rectification (islah) of one's deeds and character.
